title: light-cone-predicate-category
description: The predicate category C_cone over E_cos whose morphisms are restricted to those compatible with the light-cone structure. It inherits the four predicate-category generators (specialization, converse, two projections) and adds a fifth: light-cone restriction ρ_{e→e'} : p → p for e ≼ e', reindexing evidence along the causal order, with ρ_{e→e''} = ρ_{e'→e''} ∘ ρ_{e→e'}. The categorical form of relativistic locality: a closure rule at e consumes only its past light cone and produces at e or its future.

over-entity-set.description: the spacetime entity set E_cos the predicate category sits over

light-cone-restriction.description: the fifth generator class ρ_{e→e'} for e ≼ e'; its 1-skeleton is the causal partial order; Beck–Chevalley squares commute only when the underlying causal squares do
